heroHeadline: Drone Crashes in Romania's Vrancea County as Spanish F/A-18s Scramble Twice Near Snake Island
heroSubtitle: Romania logged three more border incidents in 24 hours: a drone crossed from Moldova on the morning of August 24 and crashed into a tree near a home in Ciușlea village, Vrancea County (no explosives, ~300m evacuation), while Spanish F/A-18s scrambled twice — once that evening near Snake Island and again the next morning near Vâlcove — after radar detected targets approaching the border, with no confirmed airspace penetration either time. Romania's own incident dashboard now counts 25 confirmed drone incursions in 2026, nearly triple 2025's total, and 47 fighter-scramble situations against 21 last year.
footerNote: Data sourced from official NATO/SHAPE and member-state defense ministry statements, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
